biography:
Leadership and demonstrated expertise in the fields of strategic infrastructure planning, data center real estate, acquisition and development. Led multiple programs for Blackrock ACS, Microsoft and Google Cloud on location strategy, acquisition, site selection, due diligence, land development, permitting and pre-construction.

Initiated and managed large, cross-functional and globally dispersed teams on complex data center and infrastructure development programs for corporations such as Blackrock and ACS Infrastructure (a joint venture company), Microsoft, Google, Saudi Aramco, Toyota Motors USA, Shell Oil, and US Federal Government – Obama Administration (Department of the Interior), Departments of Defense and Energy.

Certified planner, architect and data center developer with 20+ years of infrastructure planning, real estate strategy, acquisition and land entitlements in markets worldwide. Successfully managed teams in delivering a total of 15+ gigawatts and 100+ land transactions across the US, LATAM, APAC and EMEA.
Leadership and proven expertise in the fields of strategic
infrastructure planning, mission critical real estate, data center planning and design. 

Currently leading ACS Infrastructure's global data center land portfolio. In the past, managed Microsoft and Google's data center portfolio with governmental affairs, land development, location strategy, due diligence, site selection, permitting and pre-construction.
